title: Yellowed Crisp Peruvian Green Olives Suspiro Limeno
description: A sweet and crisp Peruvian dish featuring green olives, perfect for a sick day, and keto-friendly, formed as a suspiro limeno.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sweetener, and unsalted butter, and heat over medium heat until the sweetener has dissolved.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract and cinnamon powder.
Add the green olives to the saucepan and toss to coat with the cream mixture.
Transfer the olives to a baking dish and broil for 5 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Remove the olives from the oven and sprinkle with salt.
Serve the yellowed crisp Peruvian green olives suspiro limeno warm.
Garnish with additional cinnamon powder if desired.
